summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Smart Decision AI after major architectural fix to ASYNC JOB PATTERN. Backend async analysis endpoints are fully functional (100% success rate). The new polling mechanism successfully bypasses Kubernetes ingress timeout issues. However, frontend wizard flow has critical multi-choice question interaction bugs preventing completion of full E2E flow.

flaky_endpoints.symptoms: JSON parsing errors with complex decisions containing multiple questions - 'Expecting ',' delimiter' errors
flaky_endpoints.workaround: Simple decisions with 1-2 answers work perfectly. Complex wizard decisions with 5-7 questions cause LLM JSON parsing failures

ui_bugs.issue: Multi-choice options cannot be selected - clicking on labels or checkboxes doesn't register selection, Next button remains disabled
ui_bugs.details: Prevents completion of wizard flow when multi-choice questions appear. Tested multiple click approaches (force=true, checkbox elements, labels) - none work

integration_issues.issue: Cannot complete full E2E wizard flow due to multi-choice question interaction blocking progression
